Find errors in the translations. Each SEGMENT block holds one translation between its TEXT markers; when it also holds a SOURCE block, that is the original it translates.
Reply with only a JSON array of {"segment","kind","quote","explanation","suggestion"}. segment is the number after SEGMENT.
kind is "spelling", "grammar", "mistranslation" (the translation says something different from the original), "too_loose" (it drifts too far from the original) or "obscure" (it is unclear even given the original); the last three only for a SEGMENT that has a SOURCE block. Reply [] when there is no error.
quote is the shortest wrong span copied exactly from the TEXT of that segment, never an offset and never from the original.
explanation is one short sentence in the language of the translation; suggestion is the corrected span.
<<<SEGMENT 1
<<<SOURCE
你好，世界。
第二行
SOURCE>>>
<<<TEXT
Xin chao the gioi.
Dong thu hai
TEXT>>>
SEGMENT>>>
<<<SEGMENT 2
<<<TEXT
Mot cau khong co nguon {{source_segment}}
TEXT>>>
SEGMENT>>>
